resolved_profile.policy_telos: Reduce extraneous prose load while preserving intrinsic difficulty and supporting germane model-building load.

reader_model.reading_task: recover the argument's claims and their derivation on a single read, without leaving the page to look up a term

graph.role: index and provenance metadata only; never a gate target

pin.algorithm: SHA-256 over UTF-8 bytes, lowercase hex
pin.repin_policy: recompute at milestone transitions and grounded-source-admitting rounds; auto-accept no delta; real delta requires deliberate versioned repin; never intra-cycle

related_to_RE_predicate.primary_communities: unique integer communities of resolved seeds
related_to_RE_predicate.import_neighbors: one hop outside primary communities from a primary-community member
related_to_RE_predicate.link_contract: source and target canonical; mandatory _src and _tgt must identify the same ordered or reversed endpoint pair

hash_recipe.attestation_view_pin: newline join UTF-8-byte-sorted membership ids without trailing newline
hash_recipe.exemplar_view_pin: newline join UTF-8-byte-sorted source_key TAB normalized tier TAB source-page source_loc PDF sha256-or-dash tuples without trailing newline
hash_recipe.normalize_tier: strip whitespace-delimited em dash, en dash, or ASCII hyphen annotation; map full-text-pass to full-read and section-read-verified to section-read
hash_recipe.pdf_staging_rule: resolve source_loc from each contained wiki source page; missing PDF is dash; staging or byte change is a semantic delta

attestation.role: negative check: is this construction foreign?

exemplar.admission: deny normalized stub and unresolved; admit every other tier

exemplar_members.note: Historical dissertation anchor retained as classic context after the user-designated 2011 mature published centroid promotion.

exemplar_members.retrieval_scope: Primary mature-published centroid. Retrieve only the verified Yu-authored volume introduction (book pp. 3-10) and Yu's i-star core chapter (book pp. 11-52); do not attribute other edited-volume chapters to Yu.
exemplar_members.note: User-designated primary centroid reference for Yu's argument architecture and domain register; the full PDF is hash-bound while passage use remains section-grounded.
promoted from stub 2026-07-13 (abstract+intro read-through; mid/end guideline set not exhaustively mapped — lower-confidence surface warrant; optional deepening to full-read)

surface.question: is this term, phrase, connective, or sentence shape attested?

argument.question: is this derivation or logic-connection an insider move?

write.discipline: condition drafting on retrieved near-neighbor passages; retrieval does not determine generation

review.discipline: absence of attestation or exemplar warrant is advisory only

revise.discipline: substitute an attested construction while preserving propositional content and identity-layer boundaries

honesty_constraints: corpus retrieval conditions generation but does not determine it

aggregate.clean: no MAJOR or BLOCKER among contributing members
aggregate.borderline: exactly one independent MAJOR and no BLOCKER
aggregate.major: two or more independent MAJOR findings and no BLOCKER
aggregate.blocker: one or more contributing BLOCKER findings

above_ceiling.blocker_when: zero functional turn-points AND zero internal sentence-break signals

G.workflow_effect_while_active: findings recorded but excluded from aggregate
G.stability_mode_effect: aggregation follows runtime_modes.stability plus bound transition state

H.meaning: two complete revision cycles with H in scope
H.workflow_effect_while_active: findings recorded but excluded from aggregate
H.stability_mode_effect: aggregation follows runtime_modes.stability plus bound transition state

remediation_order: prefer semicolon or colon when the resolved style profile limits em dashes

register_provenance.graph_semantic_scope: all current research wiki markdown pages; corpus PDFs represented structurally through source_loc
